key_insight: The paper proposes a hybrid optimization strategy that first trains all parameters jointly, then refines only the low-dimensional parameters of interest with reduced-space Levenberg-Marquardt for faster and more accurate targeted recovery.
engineering_relevance: This is useful when a model has many expensive variables but only a few critical quantities must be estimated accurately, as in PDE-constrained inverse problems and scientific machine learning.
method: Partition parameters into a high-dimensional remainder block and a low-dimensional POI block.
Run joint first-order optimization over the full parameter set.
Freeze the remaining variables and apply reduced-space LM only to the POIs.
evidence_signal: Across a matrix eigenvalue problem, an inverse Bratu PINN, and a 100-dimensional nonlinear Black-Scholes DeepBSDE test, HJSO reached POI-error thresholds faster than the joint first-order baseline and improved final POI accuracy.
watch_item: The approach depends on knowing which variables are the true POIs and may not help if the POIs are not well separated from the rest of the parameter space.
paper_title: Hybrid Joint-Selective Optimization: Reduced-Space Levenberg-Marquardt Refinement of Low-Dimensional Parameters of Interest
